_comment: Guardian Action - Attack - '**Crush** - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, {t} them.' Crush is a printed keyword (in printed_keywords) and fires from the card DB keywords field - NOT authored here. STATIC_TRIGGERED on ON_CRUSH (engine dispatches ON_CRUSH only when crush_check passes, i.e. hit damage >= 4). ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO condition gates 'to a hero' (crush_check reads only damage total, not target). TAP with target OPPONENT_HERO taps the defending hero ({t} them). No other abilities - the attack itself is handled by the engine for Action - Attack cards.
